## Rosters apply right away

- **No more restarting by hand.** Choosing a season, Today's rosters or My League from the in-game menu now reloads the game by itself with the new rosters.
- Installing packs from the in-game Features screen turns the first menu tile into **Apply now**, which reloads the game with them.
- Choosing the season that's already loaded just says so instead of reloading.

## Android (early build)

- **Features download now works.** The Features screen used to say "No features available": the Android build had no address for the features list.
- **Fixed a crash when choosing a season.** Picking 2026 or 2005 in Leagues & Eras could close the game and drop you back at the setup screen.
- The APK is under **Assets**. Android is still early: if something goes wrong, use "Send the last game log" on the setup screen.

## Updating

- **From v1.4.2 or later:** choose **Install** in the launcher when v1.6.2 appears, then **Restart**.
- **From v1.4.1 or earlier:** download the package for your system under **Assets** and extract it.

Your disc, saves, settings and installed packs stay where they are.
